lighting_shading.note: Bright, sunny tropical lighting with clear directional shadows.

value_contrast.note: Strong contrast between bright highlights and deep tropical shadows.

color_palette.note: Vibrant, saturated tropical colors with complementary blue and orange.

composition_hierarchy.note: Diagonal composition leads eye from stools to the drinks.

shape_proportions.note: Stylized, chunky forms typical of modern mobile casual games.

viewpoint_depth.note: Clear depth from foreground stools to background hut.

edges_linework.note: Clean, crisp edges defined by value and color rather than lines.

rhythm_staging.note: Repetition of bar stools creates a rhythmic foreground.
